newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: A.Silva sells unit to Somague.
newsitem.headline: A.Silva sells unit to Somague.

text.p: Portuguese civil engineering group Somague has agreed to buy building subsidiary Assiconstroi from A.Silva & Silva, the companies said in a statement published in the local press on Monday.
Following the deal Somague, which is buying 100 percent of the capital of Assiconstroi, will become Portugal's biggest construction firm, overtaking Soares da Costa, market sources said.

"Somague aims to consolidate its development in civil construction; and A.Silva & Silva, besides remaining linked to construction via its units Sopol, Geosoc and MGT, will develop real estate promotion, the marketing of construction materials and its activities in car parks," the statement said.
Company officials were not immediately available.
The statement did not give the value of the deal. The local media said it was valued around 10.8 billion escudos.
Somague shares stood at 1,750 escudos, up 85, in volume of 34,300 at 1122 GMT. A.Silva & Silva shares stood at 1,600 escudos, down 75, in volume of 16,000.
